instruction: GUI Office PV Package. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm and run/eplusout.sql in the task output folder; run the OpenStudio/EnergyPlus workflow so the SQL simulation output is produced. Create 1 building story, 1 space and 1 thermal zone. Name the OS:Space GUI Office. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 6 total OS:Surface objects, split into 1 floor surface, 1 roof/ceiling surface and 4 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 1 Ground and 5 Outdoors. Add 4 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 44.80 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Add 1 OS:ShadingSurface object. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 1 ideal-loads air system, 1 zone HVAC equipment list and 1 dual-setpoint thermostat. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 15.00 m in X, 10.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 150.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 160.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
